svg.title: sharkdp/fd: 13% AI-signed commits
svg.desc: 13% of 53 recent commits in sharkdp/fd carry a disclosed AI agent signature (53 commits, last 90 days). Claude Code 7.5%, OpenAI Codex 3.8%, GitHub Copilot 1.9%. No signature found does not mean human-only.
